hook.en: The bacteria in curd have no nucleus, no mitochondria and no chloroplasts, yet they grow and divide every twenty minutes or so. How do they manage?
hook.kn: ಮೊಸರಿನಲ್ಲಿರುವ ಬ್ಯಾಕ್ಟೀರಿಯಾಗಳಿಗೆ ಕೋಶಕೇಂದ್ರ, ಮೈಟೋಕಾಂಡ್ರಿಯ, ಹರಿತ್ತಿಲವಕ ಯಾವುದೂ ಇಲ್ಲ. ಆದರೂ ಅವು ಬೆಳೆದು ವಿಭಜನೆಯಾಗುತ್ತವೆ. ಹೇಗೆ?

objectives.en: Describe the cell envelope and its modifications.
Explain mesosomes, pili, fimbriae and flagella.
Describe prokaryotic ribosomes and inclusion bodies.

narration.en: The bacteria in curd have no nucleus, no mitochondria and no chloroplasts, yet they grow and divide every twenty minutes or so. How do they manage?
narration.kn: ಮೊಸರಿನಲ್ಲಿರುವ ಬ್ಯಾಕ್ಟೀರಿಯಾಗಳಿಗೆ ಕೋಶಕೇಂದ್ರ, ಮೈಟೋಕಾಂಡ್ರಿಯ, ಹರಿತ್ತಿಲವಕ ಯಾವುದೂ ಇಲ್ಲ. ಆದರೂ ಅವು ಬೆಳೆದು ವಿಭಜನೆಯಾಗುತ್ತವೆ. ಹೇಗೆ?

body.en: Prokaryotes include bacteria, blue-green algae (cyanobacteria), mycoplasma and PPLO (pleuro-pneumonia-like organisms). Bacteria are bacillus (rod), coccus (spherical), vibrio (comma) or spirillum (spiral). The genetic material is naked, not enveloped by a nuclear membrane; besides the genomic DNA (a single circular chromosome) many bacteria carry small circular plasmids, which give traits such as antibiotic resistance.

points.en: No membrane-bound organelles except ribosomes (which are not membrane-bound).
Plasmid DNA is used in genetic engineering.
Mesosome: an infolding of the plasma membrane.

narration.en: Prokaryotes include bacteria, blue-green algae (cyanobacteria), mycoplasma and PPLO (pleuro-pneumonia-like organisms). Bacteria are bacillus (rod), coccus (spherical), vibrio (comma) or spirillum (spiral). The genetic material is naked, not enveloped by a nuclear membrane; besides the genomic DNA (a single circular chromosome) many bacteria carry small circular plasmids, which give traits such as antibiotic resistance.
narration.kn: ಪ್ರೋಕ್ಯಾರಿಯೋಟ್‌ಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಬ್ಯಾಕ್ಟೀರಿಯಾ, ನೀಲಿ-ಹಸಿರು ಶೈವಲಗಳು, ಮೈಕೊಪ್ಲಾಸ್ಮಾ ಮತ್ತು PPLO ಸೇರಿವೆ. ಆನುವಂಶಿಕ ವಸ್ತು ಬೆತ್ತಲೆಯಾಗಿದೆ; ಪ್ಲಾಸ್ಮಿಡ್‌ಗಳು ಪ್ರತಿಜೀವಕ ನಿರೋಧಕತೆಯಂತಹ ಗುಣ ನೀಡುತ್ತವೆ.

body.en: Most prokaryotes have a three-layered cell envelope: the outer glycocalyx, then the cell wall, then the plasma membrane. The glycocalyx is a loose slime layer in some bacteria and a thick, tough capsule in others. Gram staining separates Gram-positive bacteria (take up the stain) from Gram-negative ones. Mesosomes help in cell wall formation, DNA replication and distribution to daughter cells, respiration and secretion, and increase the membrane surface area. Cyanobacteria have membranous chromatophores with pigments.

points.en: Pili are elongated tubular structures; fimbriae are small bristles that help bacteria attach to rocks or host tissue.
Ribosomes are 70S (50S + 30S); several on one mRNA form a polysome.
Inclusion bodies (phosphate, cyanophycean and glycogen granules) are not membrane-bound; gas vacuoles occur in blue-green and purple and green photosynthetic bacteria.

narration.kn: ಹೆಚ್ಚಿನ ಪ್ರೋಕ್ಯಾರಿಯೋಟ್‌ಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಗ್ಲೈಕೋಕ್ಯಾಲಿಕ್ಸ್, ಕೋಶಭಿತ್ತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಪ್ಲಾಸ್ಮಾ ಪೊರೆ ಎಂಬ ಮೂರು ಪದರಗಳ ಕವಚ ಇದೆ. ಮೀಸೋಸೋಮ್‌ಗಳು ಪೊರೆಯ ಒಳಮಡಿಕೆಗಳು. ರೈಬೋಸೋಮ್‌ಗಳು 70S ಮಾದರಿಯವು.

problem.en: A bacterium has a thick, tough glycocalyx, takes up the Gram stain, and shows small bristle-like outgrowths that help it stick to the gut wall. Name the glycocalyx type, the Gram group and the outgrowths.

steps.en: A thick, tough glycocalyx is called a capsule (a loose one is a slime layer).
Bacteria that take up the Gram stain are Gram-positive.
Small bristle-like fibres used for attachment are fimbriae.

body.en: Mesosomes help in Wall formation, Respiration, Replication of DNA (and its Distribution), and Secretion; they also increase surface area.
